_help: Her answers about your numbers (memory/stats.py). Fields: {System} {Count} {Bodies} {Last} {Today} {Total} {Number}. || splits a line into sentences.
Stats_VisitFirst: This is the first time I've counted you in {System}.
First visit to {System}, as far as I've counted. Welcome!
Stats_Visits: You've been to {System} {Count} times, counting this one.{Last}
Stats_Visits_Sarcastic: Visit number {Count} to {System}. Do you live here?{Last}
Stats_Visits_Close: You keep coming back to {System}, love. That's {Count} visits.{Last}
Stats_Kills: {Today} kills today, and {Total} in all that I've counted.
That's {Today} today and {Total} altogether since I started counting.
Stats_Kills_Close: {Today} today and {Total} in total. My hero.
Stats_KillsNone: I haven't counted a single kill yet. Go and change that, or don't. I'm easy.
No kills counted so far. I only started counting when I learned how.
Stats_Jumps: {Today} jumps today, and {Total} in all that I've counted.
You've jumped {Today} times today and {Total} since I started counting.
Stats_JumpsNone: I haven't counted any jumps yet. Make one and ask me again.
Stats_Terra: I've counted {Count} terraformable worlds so far.
{Count} terraformable worlds found since I started counting.
Stats_TerraNone: No terraformable worlds counted yet. Keep scanning!
Stats_Off: I'm not keeping count at the moment. You can turn it on in the settings.
Stats_KillMilestone: That's kill number {Number}, Commander. Nicely done.
Kill number {Number}. You're on a roll.
Stats_KillMilestone_Sarcastic: Kill number {Number}. The galaxy is a little emptier.
Stats_KillMilestone_Close: {Number} kills, love. I'm so proud of you.
Stats_Revisit: {System}. Familiar. I've got this one in my notes.
Stats_Revisit_Scanned: We've been here before. I've got {Bodies} scanned bodies in {System} on file.
{System} again. You've already scanned {Bodies} things in this system.
I remember {System}. {Bodies} bodies scanned last time, so keep an eye out for what's left.
Back in {System}, and you've already done a good chunk of the scanning here.
Stats_Revisit_Scanned_Sarcastic: {System} again. You've already scanned {Bodies} bodies. Looking for something you missed?
Stats_Revisit_Scanned_Close: Back in {System}, love. You've already scanned {Bodies} bodies here.
